{{Quote|We Guardians are the Republic's first line of defense against the thousand enemies who seek to destroy it.|Guardian [[Crix Sunburris]] describes the role of the Guardians in a chapter of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
A '''Jedi Guardian''' was the name given to one of the three distinct branches of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the other two being [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]]. The Jedi Guardians' skills and talents lay in battle, a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] mirror of the [[Sith Warrior]]. Their role in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had remained largely consistent throughout its history but was first written down by the Guardian [[Jedi ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]] in the text, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.

==Description==
===Overview===
{{Quote|Guardian the title is, not warrior. Remember this, all Jedi should.|A footnote written by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in a copy of The Jedi Path|<ref name="TJP" />}}
[[File:EethKoth-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|left|300px|[[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Jedi Guardian, [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]]]
Initiated into the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tradition, Jedi Guardians began their [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprenticed to a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] or [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]. During their training, potential Guardians found that they were more easily able to master [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] in the [[Control]] family of abilities. Jedi Guardians were driven to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] for altruistic reasons, desiring to help the citizens of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Guardians focused on combining their mastery of the Force with physical abilities. They were consummate warriors, physically fit and able who had mastered [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], battle tactics, and defensive abilities. They acted as defenders of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Once Guardians completed their training, they journeyed into the wider galaxy with the intention of expanding their own knowledge and using their abilities to help those who needed them. Their commitment to their calling was taken seriously, with each mission and encounter being treated as a test that the Guardian was expected to overcome. Guardians retained a deep connection with their mentor and the Order, but their work often required them to operate independently with only tangential contact with either.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

Jedi Guardians generally followed the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], but some fell the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became corrupted, using their powers for evil and selfish reasons. These fallen Guardians applied the Force at every opportunity in stark contrast to light-sided Guardians who often sought to not use the Force for everyday tasks.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

Mainly concentrating on martial training and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]],<ref name="core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Guardians engaged in combat more than either of the other two classes of Jedi; the [[Jedi Consular|Consulars]] or the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Sentinels]]. Descended from the Order's founders on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] whose role in the galaxy was to defend the weak and uphold the laws of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Guardians were often seen as representatives of the Order and the classic Jedi weapon: the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TJP" />

Focusing all their time and effort on honing their martial skills, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who chose to pursue the role of Guardian often built their lightsabers using a blue [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]]; symbolizing solidarity and uniformity among this class, though it is not a requirement. Master Sunburris recommended spending three hours a day on running, unarmed combat, and lightsaber practice. Highly necessary during the Republic's early years of instability and strife, following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] the Guardians took on an even larger role; the [[Republic Army]] was disbanded and the Jedi were thrust into the role as defenders of the Republic. Policing the galaxy and working closely with sector and system law agencies, the Guardians worked tirelessly along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and along the borders of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] to maintain law where slavery and illegalities ran rampant. While carrying the basics of [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi equipment]], Guardians were often known to carry [[Binders/Legends|wrist binders]] for when they made an arrest.<ref name="TJP" />

While there were many sub-branches to the Guardian class, the most skilled and learned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] were granted the honorific title of "'''Warrior Master'''". It was two Warrior Masters that were said to have joined two [[Jedi Consular|Sage Masters]] in the founding of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. These [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]] were honored with [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] depictions on the main entrance stairs at the terminus of the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]].<ref name="comp">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

===Specialized paths===
There were several different paths a Jedi could take in order to hone their individual skills. Separated into four major divisions:

====Exotic Weapons Specialists====
{{Main|Jedi Weapon Master}}
Deciding to adopt a different weapon than that carried by other Jedi, Weapons Specialists sometimes worked with tools other than a lightsaber to defeat their foes. A rarity in the Order; Weapons Specialists worked with [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsabers]], [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pikes]], flails, whips, and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="TJP" />

====Lightsaber instructors====
{{Main|Jedi instructor}}
Vital to the training of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] at the Temple, lightsaber instructors were chosen by the current '''Jedi battlemaster''' after having served many long years on the front lines of battle. While the title battlemaster was taken up by many Jedi during the [[New Sith Wars]], it was eventually once more used to represent a single Jedi at each academy, recommending potential instructors to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] for appointment.<ref name="TJP" />

====Jedi ace====
{{Main|Jedi ace}}
[[File:JediGuardian-AoD.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Jedi Guardian]]
Organized under the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]], the Jedi aces were highly adept pilots and dogfighters. Piloting a variety of different [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] models over the Order's history, those specializing as Aces used their battle awareness to increase their firing accuracy and precision far beyond what a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] pilot could achieve. Early on, the Aces served side by side with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], but after its dissolution they worked closely with local defense fleets.<ref name="TJP" />

====Jedi Peacekeeper====
{{Main|Jedi Peacekeeper}}
The Jedi Peacekeepers were specialists in the art of policing the galaxy and ensuring that laws are enforced along the Outer Rim. Probably the most recognized branch of the Guardian class, these individuals served alongside Sector police and local militias to ensure peace was kept amongst the stars. The branch of Peacekeepers serving on Coruscant made up the [[Temple Security Force]], the protectors of the Jedi Temple and the greater [[Temple district/Legends|Temple district]].

==Behind the scenes==
The term Jedi Guardian was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. It was one of the eight starting classes established in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. [[Sia-Lan Wezz]] and [[Dorn Tavers]], both [[Human/Legends|Humans]], served as the character examples for the class.<ref name="RPG-Core" /> 

The term was later used in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']].

In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', Jedi Guardian is one of the Jedi classes that is available to the player on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The class is also present in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', along with two prestige counterparts: [[Jedi Weapon Master]] for light side, and [[Sith Marauder]] for dark side.

It should be noted that even though Jedi Guardians concentrated most on combat and lightsaber mastery, some Guardians were naturally so strong in the Force that they had Force ability to the degree of the [[Jedi Consular]]s. Examples include [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Likewise, certain Consulars were skilled enough with the lightsaber to fight on par with Guardians such as [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]].

In the [[Star Wars Miniatures]] set [[Champions of the Force (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Champions of the Force'']], the Jedi Guardian figure resembles [[Atris]]. The earlier Jedi Guardian miniature produced by for the Star Wars Miniatures resembles the Rodian Jedi Weapons Master from the art on the inside of the Jedi Academy Training Manuel.

The Jedi Guardian is an advanced class for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game.<ref name="Holonet-Jedi Knight">{{Holonet|classes|jedi-knight|Jedi Knight}}</ref> This advanced class specializes in the use of heavy armor, inspiring allies, and greater stamina in battle.<ref name="TORweb-STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday August 20, 2010">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref> The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[Sith Juggernaut]].<ref name="Holonet-Sith Warrior">{{Holonet|classes|sith-warrior|Sith Warrior}}</ref>
